name_reason: Compliant. Prefix data_fd2_ (game global), domain chapter, ch07 is a meaningful chapter id (chapters 01-30, not an address residue), descriptor end_scene_char_facing_table accurately reflects both purpose (chapter-7 end-scene per-character sprite facing) and data type (table/array). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Chapter 7 end-scene per-character sprite facing-direction table for the 9 characters staged in the chapter-7 recruit cutscene (recruit char #12, wuzhe kaili / 武者凱麗); third of three parallel 9-byte placement tables (X @ 0x520E4, Y @ 0x520ED, facing @ 0x520F6).
logic_summary: Read-only const source data. In fd2_chapter_07_end @ 0x232E8 it is block-copied 9 raw bytes (MOV ESI,0x520F6 ; MOV EDI,ESP ; MOVSD/MOVSD/MOVSB) onto an on-stack character-placement block (var_2c .. bStack_24), consumed one byte at a time, then the block is passed as the facing-direction argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro @ 0x233C6. No struct stride, no wider element access, no sign extension.
element_semantics: uint8, 9 entries, one per staged character; each value is a sprite facing-direction code in range 0..3 (values {0,0,0,3,1,3,1,3,1}).
notes: Memory @ 0x520F6 = [0,0,0,3,1,3,1,3,1] matches src values exactly. Exactly two xrefs from fd2_chapter_07_end (READ @ 0x23316 + DATA @ 0x23311), single reader, zero writers -> const confirmed. src/ comment (chtab.c) already accurate and refined -> comment kept, no Edit to chtab.c (so chtab.c is NOT staged). Ghidra data plate was blank (<null>) while X/Y siblings @ 0x520E4/0x520ED and the ch05 facing sibling @ 0x520DD already carry plates; created a matching plate for consistency and saved program. Romanized 武者凱麗 -> wuzhe kaili in plate per established ASCII plate convention in this object (matches Y-table plate).
